about: Test fixture: the Alaska Senate race as the site had it on Nov. 11, 2026, still counting (it was called Nov. 17), for the tests of a race still counting.

result.how: Mary Peltola led Dan Sullivan by 3,975 votes in the Division of Elections' count on Wednesday evening, Nov. 11, with tens of thousands of ballots still to count. The last ballots are counted Nov. 18; if nobody has a majority then, Alaska's ranked-choice count decides it. The state certifies by Nov. 25.

tally.counted: More than 250,000 ballots counted; tens of thousands still to count
